name: nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning
description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 30B-A3B (reasoning) is a multimodal MoE model unifying video, audio, image, and text understanding for enterprise Q&A, summarization, transcription, OCR, GUI automation, and document intelligence. Supports chain-of-thought reasoning, tool calling, and up to 256k context.
